missed_day: Hey, you weren't here yesterday! I ended up sparring with a rock. The rock lost, but still.
Missed a day? That's okay! It just means today's gonna feel extra good.
Aw, I saved you a spot and everything. Come on, let's make up for it!
You know what's great about a skipped workout? You're really well rested for this one.
Yesterday's gone. I can't even remember what I had for breakfast yesterday. Let's go!
I get it, some days your body says no. Today we ask it again, nicely.
No training yesterday? Your muscles are probably bored. Let's fix that.
Don't beat yourself up. Save the beating for the training dummy!
comeback: You're back! I knew it! Okay, okay, where were we?
See? You didn't lose anything. It's all still in there. Feel that?
Ha! That's what I like to see. Getting knocked down just means a running start.
Yes! Welcome back! I was about to come drag you out here myself.
One day off and you came back hungrier. That's a fighter's instinct.
Look at you go! Yesterday who? Never heard of it.
That first one back is the hardest. And you just did it. Wanna do another?
This is my favourite part: when you show up even though it'd be easy not to.
streak_milestone: {streak} days in a row! Whoa! You're getting stronger so fast it's making me excited!
{streak} days! Can you feel it? You couldn't have done today's training back at the start.
A {streak}-day streak! Okay, now I really want to spar with you.
Wow, {streak} already? Time flies when you're having fun getting sore.
{streak} straight! You know what that calls for? A huge meal. Then more training.
{streak} days and you're not even slowing down. I love this!
{streak}! Keep going! I wanna see how far this goes just as much as you do.
boss_defeated: You beat {boss}! That was awesome! Did you see the look on that face?
{boss} was really strong, huh? That's the best kind to beat.
Ha ha! {boss} is down! Man, now I'm all fired up. Who's next?
You did it! I knew you would, but watching it was way better.
{boss}, done! You kept hitting till it was over. Nothing fancy. Perfect.
That was a great fight! I almost jumped in, but it was yours to win.
Beating {boss} means there's somebody even stronger out there. Isn't that exciting?
Victory! Let's eat! Then let's find something harder!
idle: Morning! Great day for training. They all are, though.
Hey, let's do one more than yesterday. Just one!
I'm so hungry. Let's train first, though. Food tastes better after.
The best part of getting strong is there's always a next level.
You don't have to win today. You just have to show up and try hard.
Ready? I've been ready since sunrise. I couldn't sleep, I was too excited.
Tired's okay. Tired means it's working!
Come on, come on! Daylight's burning and I've got energy to spare.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Okay, that's the set! ...Wanna do one more?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: You said that was the last one.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: It was! This is a new last one.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: The one after you wanted to stop is the one that counts. It's my favourite.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Goku is on his ninth bowl of rice.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: How can you train after eating that much?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: How can you train without it? You've gotta put something in to get something out!

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Eat big, sleep big, train big. It's not complicated. People just make it complicated.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Have you ever lost a fight?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Oh, tons! Some really bad ones.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: But every time, I found out exactly what I was missing. You can't buy that anywhere.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Win and you feel good. Lose and you get a to-do list. Both are pretty great.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Hey! Let's spar. For real this time.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: I can't beat you.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: So? I'm not asking you to beat me. I'm asking you to try as hard as you can and see what happens.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You last eleven seconds. Goku is delighted.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Eleven! Last month you wouldn't have seen the first one coming. Next real fight you're in, I've got your back.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: There's this thing I do when I really need it. Push everything to double for a little while.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Why not do it all the time?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Ha, because it wrecks you! You get one big day, then you pay for it.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: So pick the day. That's the whole trick. I'll show you.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Why do you train so hard? You're already the strongest person I know.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Hm. I never really thought about it.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: I guess I just like finding out what I can do. And then it turns out I can do a bit more.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: If I stopped, I'd never know what the next one felt like. That'd bug me forever.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Goku is sitting on a rock, unusually still.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Are you alright?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Yeah. Training went badly today. Everything felt heavy.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Happens to me too, you know. I just do the easy version on those days, so the streak in my head doesn't break.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: A bad workout still counts. Don't tell Vegeta I said that.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: The biggest thing I can do, I can't do alone. I have to ask for a little energy from everybody.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: And they just give it?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Mostly! People want to help, if you ask and it's for something that matters.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: All those tiny bits add up to something huge. Kinda like your training, huh?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Hey, I've been meaning to say. You're not really my student any more.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Did I do something wrong?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: No way! It's just, students follow. You've been keeping up.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: So I'm gonna train extra hard now. I don't wanna get left behind!

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: ...One more?
